title-small.purpose: App bar title, section headings beside a colour key.

label-small.purpose: Tiny lowercase screen-cell labels and lifecycle stages.

mono.purpose: Data only: commits, paths, counts, ids, dates; one pixel under the role it replaces.

motion.name: micro
motion.purpose: Button, field and card state changes (hover wash, seam to ink).

motion.name: route-fade
motion.purpose: Route change is a fade; removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: glyph-still
motion.purpose: Default for every glyph that is not live. No hover animation.

motion.name: glyph-once
motion.purpose: One beat (ease-out-back, one small overshoot) when a state arrives: worker online or busy, spec ready, approved, readiness reached.

motion.name: glyph-loop
motion.purpose: Only while work runs: refinement queued or running, outbox sending, CI running, waiting for a worker.

motion.name: run-arc
motion.purpose: The run arc spins once per 1400ms while a refinement is live.

motion.name: dial
motion.purpose: Readiness dial fills to value (ease-out-cubic); jumps under reduced motion.

motion.name: tooltip-wait
motion.purpose: Delay before the words behind a glyph-only state appear.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Loops stop, one-shots do not play, dials jump to value, route fades are removed.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Below this a board lane is 85% of the screen so the next lane peeks in; above it lanes share the window from 288px to 360px.

breakpoints.name: task-two-column
breakpoints.purpose: At and above this the task page puts the 360px activity rail beside the spec column, which centres in the remaining space; below, the rail stacks under the spec.

breakpoints.name: min-width
breakpoints.purpose: Every layout works at this phone width.

layout.name: ledger
layout.purpose: Home and Workers centred column; the app bar shares the inset.

focus.purpose: Keyboard focus on buttons, fields and cards; never orange.

narrative.overview:
Every worker and every refinement run is a small instrument. The app is a light anodized shell (graphite in the dark edition) carrying round colour keys and, where something is live or worth a glance, one black screen strip on which Lucide line glyphs sit over tiny lowercase labels and mono readouts. State is read first as colour and motion, then as words; words drop to the smallest size that still reads.

The shell is flat and quiet. Depth comes from three neutral fields (shell, sheet, side field) separated by one-pixel seams, never from shadow. Prose (briefs, spec sections) stays plain readable Manrope at a 680px measure, with the agent's RFC 2119 keywords set as dark key-caps. Orange is scarce on purpose: it marks only what is running right now or waiting on the person.

Motion has one grammar. Glyphs are still by default, loop only while work runs, play once when a state arrives, and freeze entirely under reduced motion. Light and dark both ship and follow the system setting.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral anodized shell, three tonal fields, hairline seams, no shadows, gradients or glass.
Colour-coded round keys: orange live, green online/verified, blue evidence, grey idle.
At most one black screen strip per screen, for live or summary state only.
Lucide line glyphs as the only icon language, animated only while something is live.
Manrope 800 for hierarchy, JetBrains Mono for data only.

rules.name: The Orange Means Now Rule
rules.body: Orange appears only on something live or awaiting the person: the running refinement, "Spec ready for review", and Approve spec. Starting work is not live: "Refine with AI" is an ink button and "Refine again" is an outline button.

rules.name: The Key Colour Is The State Rule
rules.body: A key's colour carries its state; its glyph names the thing. Never encode the same state in a second colour on the same element.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for data only: commits, paths, counts, ids, dates. Never for headings, labels, buttons or prose. The one typographic exception is the key-cap, which sets the agent's own normative keyword as a token.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: No shadows, gradients, glass or blur anywhere, including dragged cards, menus, dialogs and snackbars. If something needs to stand forward, it gets a seam or the black screen, not a shadow.

dos: Do reserve orange for live or awaiting-you states: the running refinement, "Spec ready for review", and Approve spec.
Do render "Refine with AI" as an ink button and "Refine again" as an outline button.
Do keep glyphs still by default; loop only while work runs (refinement queued or running, outbox sending, CI running, waiting for a worker) and play once when a state arrives.
Do freeze every glyph, dial and transition under reduced motion.

Do use at most one black screen strip per screen, and only when it carries live or summary state. On home it appears only when items are unsent or the app is offline; on the task page its footer is the status readout.
Do set the agent's MUST/SHOULD keywords as dark key-caps (ink fill, sheet text, mono 600, 4px radius).
Do use JetBrains Mono for data only: commits, paths, line ranges, counts, ids, dates.
Do separate surfaces with the three neutral fields and one-pixel seams.
Do name icons by job through the Glyph enum; screens never reference a library icon class.
donts: Don't use orange to start work, decorate, or mark focus on idle content.
Don't add hover animation to glyphs.
Don't put a second screen strip on a screen, or show one that carries only static decoration.
Don't set headings, labels, buttons or prose in mono.
Don't use shadows, gradients, glass or blur, including on dragged cards and overlays.
Don't add colours, font families or radii outside the tokens in this file.
